note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS New Testament wording and the self-rendered Old Testament (much of this book quotes the Song of Solomon) the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…' (2 Cor 12:2, Neh 9:17, Song 6:4-9, Isa 8:8). The sermons' refrains are worded identically wherever they recur: Song 5:16 «ሁሉ ነገሩ ደስ የሚያሰኝ ነው» ('altogether lovely'), Song 4:7 «በሁሉ ነገር ውብ ነሽ … ምንም እንከን የለብሽም», Song 2:3 «በደስታ በጥላው ሥር ተቀመጥኩ፤ ፍሬውም በአፌ ጣፋጭ ነበረ», Song 2:17 «ቀኑ እስኪተነፍስ ጥላዎቹም እስኪሸሹ ድረስ፣ ውዴ፣ ተመለስ», Matt 11:28 «እኔም ዕረፍት እሰጣችኋለሁ», John 14:18 «አባት እንደሌላቸው ልጆች አልተዋችሁም» (both 'comfortless' and 'orphans'), 1 Pet 2:24 «እርሱ ራሱ ኃጢአቶቻችንን በገዛ አካሉ ተሸክሞ ወደ መስቀል ወጣ», Ps 17:3 «በሌሊትም ወደ እኔ መጣህ». Acts 9:6's question is quoted from Acts 22:10 (ch2). Quotations the first inventory missed are re-quoted too (1 Pet 2:18-24 in ch21, Ezek 16:8-15 in ch8, Song 6:4-9, Heb 2:14-15, Ps 103:12 and others).

Where OWB's words force it, the author's sentence bends minimally: 'my well-beloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill' (Isa 5:1, ch9) quotes OWB's «ለም አፈር ባለው ኮረብታ» with a one-time bridge (ማለትም እጅግ ፍሬያማ በሆነ ኮረብታ ላይ) at its first exposition, while the sermon's own echoes keep 'very fruitful'; prose echoes of the refrains ('visit', 'altogether lovely', 'all fair', 'comfortless') stay the author's.

A `self_rendered` row is an allusion, a hymn line, the author's adaptation ('Give me Christ or else I die', 'I will come to you by My Spirit'), a term, or a paraphrase in the author's own sentence; the translator's wording stands, with the reason in `why`. Two AV readings the author argues from are kept (for the founder): the margin's 'mountains of division' (Song 2:17, ch5) and 'born like a wild ass's colt' (Job 11:12, ch21). Translations of this book are ai_unreviewed until a reviewer approves them.
